name: Action item tracker
why: Turns email threads into one register with owners, due dates and source links, the same shape as the deal tracker when a file starts from a messy inbox.

name: Weekly status update writer
why: Writes a one-page status report with risks and decisions needed, useful for the agent's Monday pipeline review.

name: Due task follow up drafter
why: Turns due tasks into follow-up drafts that show missing facts, matching the chase step for outstanding documents.

name: Staff phishing rules briefer
why: Builds a phishing rule sheet and a short drill for the office, reinforcing the wire-safety rules every coordinator and agent follows.

name: Extract a scanned document and verify key facts
why: Pulls dates and names from a scanned contract with page numbers and uncertain readings, a first pass before the key dates table.

name: Dull update email rewriter
why: Sharpens a flat update so buyers and sellers read it, useful when templates start to feel routine.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks a reply to an unhappy client for promises nobody has approved, before the agent gives the fresh yes.

name: Handover note writer
why: Writes a note the next coordinator can act on from day one when a file changes hands mid-deal.

name: Prepare questions for a property viewing
why: Builds a buyer's viewing questions, a helpful extra for buyer-side agents before an offer is made.

name: Trace why work keeps missing deadlines
why: Maps where repeated work waits and why deadlines slip, for a brokerage whose files keep running late.
